name: JTF International Holdings Limited
summary: JTF International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the blending and selling of fuel oil in the People's Republic of China. It also sells fuel, refined oil and other petrochemical products, such as methyl tertiary butyl ether, xylene, xylene mixture, and asphalt. JTF International Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, the People's Republic of China. JTF International Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Thrive Shine Limited.
